slots.hypothesis: F = df·R²/(1−R²) of the 50-day link between daily minute-amount dispersion and the amount centroid. It scores +1.51 (train 1.53 / valid 1.51), is scale-free and its score does not come from convexity. Because it is an R², measurement noise in the centroid pushes it down on thin stocks, so it may partly rank measurement precision (Gassen, Ashbaugh-Skaife & Veenman 2020; Scholes & Williams 1977). The periphery holds precision fixed in three ways: (i) cs_bucket_rank / rank residual within deciles of the centroid's 50-day std, the 20-day zero-return ratio, the 20-day minute-amount gini, the known family and the timing level; (ii) a placebo difference against the price-move-centroid F, which has the same precision exposure; (iii) the coupling sign that F throws away. 14 seeds; none are smoothing or monotone rewrites.

Tug of war between the opening call auction and the continuous session: of the same total move, how much was made overnight (prev close to open) and how much intraday. The main seed residualizes the 5/10/20-day cumulative overnight return on the total return in rank space, which by construction lies in the null space of the 20-day reversal control. Other seeds: LPS rank difference; ranking within volatility deciles (Qiao-Dam T+1 discount); overnight after a down session (An-Huang-Li 2022); one-price limit days dropped; ts_corr(O, I); the auction's share of price discovery. Back-adjusted price ratios are continuous across ex-dates. No head in the library uses cross-day prices. Literature: Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019, Berkman et al. 2012, Qiao-Dam 2020, An et al. 2022. 14 seeds.
